steps.title: Welcome to OligInvest
steps.text: Welcome to OligInvest. This one-minute guide shows where things are. You can skip it and return to it in Learn.

steps.title: Portfolio → Accounts
steps.text: Start with an account matching your broker account, such as “XTB — regular” or “XTB — IKE”.

steps.title: Portfolio → Import
steps.text: Import history from XTB or mBank. You will first see a preview and reconciliation against the broker balance — nothing is saved without your confirmation.

steps.title: Learn → Demo
steps.text: No data yet? Demo mode shows a fictional portfolio you can explore.

steps.title: Portfolio value
steps.text: Value in PLN with the data time and source. “Delayed ~15 min” means quotes are not current.

steps.title: Daily P/L
steps.text: Change since the previous close, excluding today's deposits and withdrawals.

steps.title: Explanations beside numbers
steps.text: Each number has an explanation: what it measures, how to read it and what to watch for.

steps.title: Information and education
steps.text: OligInvest helps you analyze and learn — it does not advise. You make your own decisions.
